## Services

- Building cleaning in Solingen
- Stairwell and apartment-building cleaning

- Sanitary and hygiene cleaning

## Verified current operations

- SauberPlus currently provides recurring cleaning for two production sites, six residential stairwells, one small coffee roastery with a shop area, one supermarket and one childcare facility.
- Service scope and schedules are agreed, documented and invoiced through the company's internal administration.
- Client names, addresses, invoice numbers, amounts and other private records are not public.
